description: Machine-readable map from Fortlet Improvement Proposals to implementation evidence. Conformant entries require tests; partial entries require gaps; update this file with the code that changes conformance.

entries.title: Project-scoped capsule architecture
gaps: Harness adapters do not yet own persistent paths or credential policy.
Automated coverage checks staged error formatting but does not exercise each live launch failure stage.
Automated coverage does not yet exercise project-resolution precedence, broad-root scratch behavior, capsule topology and concurrency, or terminal semantics.
Status, stop, restart, logs, and tool-update management commands are not implemented.
Interactive and background workload leases are not yet represented explicitly.
Declarative project environment activation and private overlays are not implemented.
The host-side publication transaction is not implemented.
A supported standalone installation path that does not require Nix is not implemented.
Native x86_64-linux package verification is outstanding.

entries.title: Optional transparent harness shims
gaps: Runner evidence reached Fortlet through both packaged shims, but MicroSandbox VM creation failed before either guest harness executed.
Interactive TTY, resize, and signal preservation are inherited from the explicit launch path but are not independently exercised through the shims.
